title: Protocol for the Generation and Statistical Validation of the SMARTCLOTH-Database for Dietary Control in Diabetes
author: María García-Rodríguez
materials: Install the required dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt

steps.title: Clone the Repository
steps.instruction: Clone the public code repository from GitHub using Git.

substeps.instruction: Run: git clone https://github.com/i22almoj/smartcloth-gendie.git
Change to the root directory: cd smartcloth-gendie

steps.title: Prepare Environment and Data
steps.instruction: Set up the Python environment and verify required configuration files.

substeps.instruction: Verify that models.json and generator_rules.json are located in the data/ directory
Create a Python virtual environment: python -m venv .venv
Activate the virtual environment (Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate; Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate)

steps.title: Run Generation Pipeline
steps.instruction: Execute the main pipeline script with the specified seed.

substeps.instruction: Run: python main.py --seed 42
Confirm that output.json, 1_models.xlsx, 2_menus.xlsx, 3_analysis.xlsx, frecuencies.xlsx, and validation_dataset.xlsx are generated in the outputs/ directory

steps.title: Install Statistical Software
steps.instruction: Install JAMOVI Desktop (version 2.3.28 or a compatible version) from https://www.jamovi.org

steps.title: Verify Nutritional Data
steps.instruction: Verify that each row contains nutritional values for both models (BDCA/FCDB reference values and SMARTCLOTH values) and their corresponding differences.

substeps.instruction: Check energy (kcal), carbohydrates (g), proteins (g), and lipids (g)
Check differences: Dif. Kcal, Dif. Carb, Dif. Prot, and Dif. Lip

steps.title: Subset Dataset in JAMOVI
steps.instruction: Use the Level column in JAMOVI to subset the dataset according to the required aggregation level.

substeps.instruction: FOOD for individual food items
DISH for composite dishes
GROUP for food-group level summaries
DAY for complete daily menus

steps.title: Assess Distribution of Differences
steps.instruction: In JAMOVI, assess the distribution of the differences using specific statistical tests and plots.

substeps.instruction: Perform Kolmogorov–Smirnov test with Lilliefors correction
Generate P–P plots
Generate Q–Q plots

steps.title: Calculate Intraclass Correlation Coefficient
steps.instruction: In JAMOVI, calculate the ICC using the ICC(3,k) model.

substeps.instruction: Use two-way mixed effects
Use absolute agreement
Calculate 95% confidence intervals
Perform the ICC analysis independently at the aggregation levels reported in the manuscript

steps.title: Evaluate Agreement and Export Results
steps.instruction: Perform final agreement analysis and export the results.

substeps.instruction: Generate Bland–Altman plots to evaluate agreement between both methods
Export the statistical outputs and figures to obtain the final validation results

description: Open `validation_dataset.xlsx` and verify that it contains the worksheet `validation_dataset`. Verify that the `validation_dataset` worksheet contains rows labelled by analysis level in the `Level` column, including: - `FOOD`, - `DISH`, - `GROUP`, - `DAY`. Import `validation_dataset.xlsx` into JAMOVI for the final statistical analys Generate the summary tables reporting the nutritional differences between SMARTCLOTH and FCDB, including mean (SD) and range (minimum–maximum).
